result.instructions: Tools for Cyberimpact, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my last 5 mailings had the best open and click rates?"; "List the addresses that hard-bounced in the last 30 days."; "Show how many members are in each of my groups.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cyberimpact data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cyberimpact_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cyberimpact_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cyberimpact_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. cyberimpact_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Check the connection and show which Cyberimpact account the API token belongs to (username, email, account name). GET /ping.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List subscribed contacts (members) with name, email, language, consent type, mailing counts and custom fields. status: active (in at least one group, default), orphans (in no group) or all. Filter by the date a member joined or was last updated. Bounced and unsubscribed members have their own tools. GET /members.

joinedOnFrom.description: Joined on or after this date.

joinedOnTo.description: Joined on or before this date (whole day).

updatedOnFrom.description: Updated on or after this date.

updatedOnTo.description: Updated on or before this date (whole day).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member
tools.title: Get member
tools.description: One member by email address or id: all attributes, consent type, mailings received/opened/clicked and custom fields (keyed by custom field id; see cyberimpact_list_custom_fields). GET /members/{key}.

key.description: The member's email address or numeric id.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_groups
tools.title: Get member's groups
tools.description: The groups a member belongs to (id, title, public/private, dynamic). GET /members/{key}/groups.

key.description: The member's email address or numeric id.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_mailings
tools.title: Get member's mailings
tools.description: The mailings a member received (use it to see what a contact was sent and when). GET /members/{key}/mailings.

key.description: The member's email address or numeric id.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_member_consent
tools.title: Get member consent
tools.description: A member's consent record: consent type, relation type, consent date, expiration and proof (for CASL compliance checks). GET /members/{key}/consent.

key.description: The member's email address or numeric id.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_bounced_members
tools.title: List bounced members
tools.description: Members whose last mailing hard-bounced (invalid addresses to clean up), with the bounce date. GET /members/bounced.

bouncedOnFrom.description: Bounced on or after this date.

bouncedOnTo.description: Bounced on or before this date (whole day).

updatedOnFrom.description: Updated on or after this date.

updatedOnTo.description: Updated on or before this date (whole day).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_unsubscribed_members
tools.title: List unsubscribed members
tools.description: Members who unsubscribed, with the unsubscribe date. These contacts must not be mailed again. GET /members/unsubscribed.

unsubscribedOnFrom.description: Unsubscribed on or after this date.

unsubscribedOnTo.description: Unsubscribed on or before this date (whole day).

updatedOnFrom.description: Updated on or after this date.

updatedOnTo.description: Updated on or before this date (whole day).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The account's custom member fields (id, name, type text/date/integer/decimal). Member customFields are keyed by these ids. GET /customfields.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the account's groups (mailing lists) with member and mailing counts, public/private and dynamic flags. Use the ids to target mailings and opt-ins. GET /groups.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: One group by id with its member count, mailing count and flags. GET /groups/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_group_members
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: The members of one group, with the same member filters as cyberimpact_list_members. GET /groups/{id}/members.

joinedOnFrom.description: Joined on or after this date.

joinedOnTo.description: Joined on or before this date (whole day).

updatedOnFrom.description: Updated on or after this date.

updatedOnTo.description: Updated on or before this date (whole day).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_mailings
tools.title: List mailings
tools.description: List mailings by state: sent (default, archived ones excluded), scheduled (queued to go out) or archived. Each has id, subject, language, send/schedule date, recipient count and sender. Optionally only mailings sent to one group. GET /mailings/{sent|scheduled|archived}.

group_id.description: Only mailings sent to this group id.

sort.description: Sort order (date_sent_* only applies to archived mailings).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_mailing
tools.title: Get mailing
tools.description: One mailing by id with its results: sent/delivered/stopped counts, views, clicks, delivery/click/view rates, per-link clicks, recipient groups, sender and body (HTML/text, cut at 20 000 characters). GET /mailings/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_mailing_recipients
tools.title: List mailing recipients
tools.description: Who received a mailing and what happened: kind = all, delivered, stopped, hard_bounced, soft_bounced, unsubscribed, opened or clicked. Optionally only recipients from one group. GET /mailings/{id}/recipients[/{kind}].

group_id.description: Only recipients that belong to this group id.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the account's email templates (id, title, created/updated). GET /templates.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_template
tools.title: Get template
tools.description: One template by id with its HTML and text body (cut at 20 000 characters). GET /templates/{id}.

tools.name: cyberimpact_get_batch
tools.title: Get batch
tools.description: Status of a bulk batch job (NEW, PROCESSING or COMPLETED) and its result. Set show_error_details to list the per-member errors. GET /batches/{id}.

show_error_details.description: Include the details of each error.

tools.name: cyberimpact_add_member
tools.title: Add member
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact as a subscribed member WITHOUT a confirmation email (implied consent) and put it in the given groups; the contact can then be mailed. Only use it for people who really gave their consent (CASL); to ask the person to confirm first use cyberimpact_send_optin. A member that already exists is rejected by the API. Throttled by Cyberimpact; for many contacts use the app's import. POST /members.

group_ids.description: Group ids to subscribe the member to (see cyberimpact_list_groups).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. CA.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id (see cyberimpact_list_custom_fields).

tools.name: cyberimpact_update_member
tools.title: Update member
tools.description: WRITE: change only the given attributes of a member (other attributes stay as they are). The old values of the changed fields are overwritten and not recoverable through the API. Set new_email to change the address. PATCH /members/{key}.

key.description: The member's email address or numeric id.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. CA.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id (see cyberimpact_list_custom_fields).

tools.name: cyberimpact_add_member_to_groups
tools.title: Add member to groups
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing member to more groups (existing group memberships are kept). Being in a group makes the member a recipient of mailings sent to it. Returns the member's groups after the update. POST /members/{key}/groups.

key.description: The member's email address or numeric id.

group_ids.description: Group ids to add the member to.

tools.name: cyberimpact_send_optin
tools.title: Send opt-in email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL to the given address: an opt-in confirmation request. The person is added to the groups only after they confirm (the member is created if it does not exist). Use this instead of cyberimpact_add_member when you do not have the person's consent yet. Only call it after the user has approved sending to this address, and set confirm_send to true. Throttled by Cyberimpact. POST /members/optins.

email.description: The address that receives the confirmation email.

group_ids.description: Group ids the person joins once they confirm.

optinConfirmUrl.description: Page the person lands on after confirming (http:// or https:// URL).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. CA.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id (see cyberimpact_list_custom_fields).

confirm_send.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved emailing this address.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_group
tools.title: Create group
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty group (mailing list). A public group can be offered on subscription forms; a private one is internal. Groups cannot be deleted through this server. POST /groups.

is_public.description: true = public group, false = private group.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_template
tools.title: Create template
tools.description: WRITE: create a new email template from HTML and/or text. It is only saved in the account; nothing is sent. POST /templates.

bodyHtml.description: HTML body. At least one of bodyHtml or bodyText is required.

bodyText.description: Plain-text body. At least one of bodyHtml or bodyText is required.

tools.name: cyberimpact_create_mailing
tools.title: Schedule mailing
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO CUSTOMERS: create a mailing scheduled to be sent at send_at to every member of the chosen groups. It goes out for real unless it is cancelled in the Cyberimpact app before send_at. Only call it after the user has approved the subject, body, sender and groups, and set confirm_send to true. mail_from must be a validated sender address of the account. A mailing cannot be deleted through this server. POST /mailings.

group_ids.description: Groups whose members receive the mailing (see cyberimpact_list_groups; check member counts first).

send_at.description: When to start sending, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH:mm:ss'. Cyberimpact reports dates in Eastern time (EST/EDT).

bodyHtml.description: HTML body. At least one of bodyHtml or bodyText is required.

bodyText.description: Plain-text body. At least one of bodyHtml or bodyText is required.

mail_from.description: From address; must be a validated sender in the account.

confirm_send.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved sending this mailing to these groups.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Cyberimpact
prompts.description: What you can do with Cyberimpact here, with example requests to try.
